grouping_principle: Alcohol use counselling is a distinct Reason for Encounter that requires raw beverage, frequency and amount data plus change, withdrawal, harm and patient-goal context rather than a single alcohol-status response.

coverage_goal: beverage type frequency amount per occasion largest-day amount last use duration and context
recent reduction craving control morning use tolerance and prior severe withdrawal history
previous change attempts supports response readiness target timing and triggers
injury hazardous use role physical mental sleep medicine pregnancy and support context
acute safety patient concern expected help uncertainty provenance terminology and clinician handoff

definition_of_done: current KDCA NICE NIAAA and build-time STOM source manifest with refresh metadata
validated instruments are referenced but not reproduced as dynamic questions or scores
atomic pattern withdrawal impact and change questions with conditional detail collection
routine former-use pregnancy emergency urgent remote and dataAbsentReason simulations
privacy validator build unit all-simulation mapping ValueSet and Coverage gates pass
constraints: Do not diagnose alcohol use disorder, intoxication or withdrawal from interview answers.
Do not calculate AUDIT, AUDIT-C, CIWA-Ar or another instrument score unless the official instrument is separately governed.
Do not advise abrupt cessation, prescribe treatment or define a personally safe alcohol amount during collection.
Keep generated content unreviewed and research_only until clinical, Korean service and terminology review.
